question_1.q: What is the Recursive AI Protocol?
question_1.a: Every time you generate or pay on AIVIVE, a programmable share of revenue flows on-chain into a buyback and burn. Use the product — the underlying network asset becomes rarer.

question_2.a: Yes. All Pro and Enterprise plans include a full commercial license for generated assets.

question_3.q: Can I edit specific parts of an image?
question_3.a: Our new Inpainting 2.0 allows you to brush over specific areas and describe changes with natural language.
